verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI has documented natural-language interfaces: the `clai` CLI for chatting with LLMs from the terminal or browser, `Agent.to_cli_sync()` to run any agent as a chat CLI, and a terminal coding agent with file access, an allowlisted shell and planning. The framework itself is still built and configured in typed Python code, so natural-language commands drive agents built with it rather than the framework. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of the framework itself (defining and configuring agents, tools and evals), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI and coding-agent experience.
